patch.summary: Is Cognism worth it? Premium B2B sales intelligence platform focused on verified contact data, phone-verified mobiles (Diamond Data®), European/EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment for outbound and RevOps teams.. Strong when EMEA / UK / DACH outbound teams that need phone-verified mobiles and GDPR-friendly data posture. Weak when Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach.

sections.heading: Cognism ROI gate for evaluators
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if contact data + prospecting are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Dynamics 365.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Sales Prospecting Standard, Sales Prospecting Pro, CRM Enrichment.

sections.heading: Who Cognism is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Cognism when EMEA coverage, phone-verified mobiles, and compliance posture are the buying criteria and you already have (or will buy) a sequencer..

Avoid if: Compare ZoomInfo for NA enterprise depth, Apollo for self-serve data+sequences, and Lusha for lighter enrichment..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with ZoomInfo on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Cognism price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / network coverage vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
